question_text: Discuss one benefit and one limitation of combining measurements from many distributed weather stations instead of depending on one station.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: Many locations provide wider geographical coverage and can reveal local differences. However, uneven sensor quality or network failures may make readings inconsistent or unavailable. Calibration and validation are needed before combining data; more sources do not automatically guarantee accuracy.
